visualCharacteristics: Two-column static page layout: a wide main column of editor text beside an aside of sidebar cards (Contact, Follow, ...).
contentPattern: Row 1: main column, free-form text (headings, paragraphs, lists, links). Each further row: one sidebar card (heading, then its items; an image cell for a logo).
usage: Body of static/informational pages such as the agency directory and community engagement page.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any page body with a text column and contact/follow sidebar cards; use (mist) when the main column sits on the light mist band.
